name: Precision Molding Services Inc
old_description: provides more than 600 different varieties of custom-designed, plastic injection
about:
Precision Molding, Inc. (PMI) operates from Sparta, Tennessee, where it was founded in 1987 by Sarah and Doug together with co‑partner Mr. Phillips; the couple later bought out Phillips’ interest and have run the company since.

The shop specializes in high‑pressure injection, insert and blow molding, running more than 40 thermoplastic presses — including injection, vertical and blow molding machines from Van Dorn, Nissei and Milacron — with blow molding shot sizes from 5 to 25 pounds. Secondary operations include pad printing, hot stamping, metal stamping and assembly, plus design‑for‑manufacturability consulting and mold fabrication through a partner tool shop. PMI produces over 600 distinct part numbers for a varied customer base.

Customers span multiple sectors; a named example is Tree‑Guard Inc., for which PMI injection‑molds a nursery‑industry product. The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer‑driven approach from concept through production.

PMI cites its ISO 9001:2015 certification, a clean, climate‑controlled production environment and a zero‑defect quality goal as differentiators, aiming to deliver value‑added service and precision molding in a single source.
